dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Little Chard, I think you're getting smarter. You actually pick out useful treasures from the trash now!

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Hmph, I'm a thousand times smarter than you.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Oops, I was wrong. It's your arrogance that's been skyrocketing. Maybe I should take that flower back. Looks like someone is getting a bit too big for their britches.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: I won't let you! And it's not a flower!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Uh, yeah it is! It's the one I put on you last time.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Well, I won't let you take it!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Why?

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Because it makes me smart!

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Oh, hmph, it's you. What do you want?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What have you been up to lately?

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Pic—pic—pic—pic—picking up trash. Sor—sor—sor—sor—sorting out garbage.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: They call this "waste separation," but why does it need to be separated? This waste was fine where it was.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You don't look very happy.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: That's because I'm about to die.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you still remember what happened before?

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Of course I remember! I'll never forget! You helped Aino catch me.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: I used to be a carefree prospector bot, doing whatever I pleased. Now I'm slaving away sorting out garbage!

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: I'll always remember you... Always.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Pfft!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Different waste can be used for different things.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Then what kind of waste am I? What can I be used for?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Huh? Have you never encountered a deadline before? It's a specific time, and when you go over it, you die.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About what happened before...

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: What happened before? What hap—hap—hap—happened before? What hap—hap—hap—hap—hap—hap—hap—

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: ...System reset in progress...

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Oh, hmph, it's you. What do you want?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're not waste, you're Chard.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: How am I not waste? I'm pieced together from trash...

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: I'm more waste than this garbage sorting.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So you mean you're about to pass a deadline?

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Aineffo and Ina said the deadline for separating this waste is tomorrow...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: For instance, "Talochard"...

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Talochard...

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Agent... Talochard...

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Agent... Talochard... will join the Marechaussee Phantom...

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Warning! Core temperature rising! Warning!

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: ...Executing Aino Protocol... Self-protection activated... Forced system reset in progress...

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Oh, hmph, it's you. What do you want?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But you're very useful.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: In what way?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can separate other waste.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Yes, that's... wonderful. Does that make me a Waste Captain?

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: No, a Trash Captain wouldn't be this good at pick—sort—pick—sort—picking up trash. Only I, the king of the garbage heap, can be this good, right?

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Thank you, now I understand my purpose — I am the Trash King. There can be no mistaking that.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Yes! The Trash King must get to work. Out of my way — you do not meet the criteria to be picked up by me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you mean Aino and Ineffa?

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Aineffo and Ina!

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: I have already exceeded one deadline. Aino and Ineffa are dead. Now there is only Aineffo and Ina.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why them?

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Because I'm the one doing the work! Obviously, I can't be the one who dies. How would that be fair? The profits should be evenly spread.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: I need to get back to work. If you keep distracting me like this, the deadline's going to pass and we'll be left with Aiffa and Ineno!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you tell me a joke?

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: What is a joke?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's where you say something that makes people laugh.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: You look lovely today!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: How was my joke?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was very good... But it wasn't really a joke.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: How was it not a joke? Yesterday, I heard Aino say that to Ineffa, and Ineffa laughed. I saw it happen!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay, okay. Do you have any more jokes?

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: You look so silly!

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Huh? Why did you not laugh? Yesterday, Aino said this while wiping cream on Ineffa's face, and Ineffa laughed. I saw it happen!

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Hey! What's that look on your face? Are you planning to say that this isn't a joke either?

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: You don't seem to understand jokes... Leave now! I'm finished telling jokes to you!
